abstract_sentences.text: Solving complex geometric problems inherently requires interleaved reasoning: a tight alternation between constructing diagrams and performing logical deductions.
Although recent Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in visual generation and plotting, we identify a counter-intuitive and underexplored phenomenon.
Naively applying Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) on interleaved plot–solution data leads to a substantial degradation in reasoning performance compared to text-only baselines.

evidence.anchor: degradation in reasoning performance compared to text-only baselines

abstract_sentences.text: We argue that this failure stems from a fundamental limitation of SFT, which primarily induces distributional alignment: the model learns to reproduce the surface format of interleaved plotting but fails to internalize the causal dependency between the generated plot and reasoning steps.

evidence.anchor: fails to internalize the causal dependency

abstract_sentences.text: To overcome this limitation, we propose Faire (Functional alignment for interleaved reasoning), a reinforcement learning framework that enforces three casual constraints to move beyond superficial imitation toward functional alignment.

evidence.anchor: propose Faire and three casual constraints

abstract_sentences.text: Extensive experiments show that Faire induces a qualitative shift in model behavior in which the plotting is effectively internalized, yielding competitive performance on challenging geometric reasoning benchmarks.

evidence.anchor: visual plot serves as an essential cognitive scaffold

final_judgment.single_storyline: 几何交错推理要求图形成为可执行、可验证且能供下一步 deduction 读取的中间状态。SFT 学到交替格式并产生干扰；Faire 用三视角 verifier、gated reward 与 GRPO 把合法性、可读性、语义意图和后续答案连接起来。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留 Figure 1 的负迁移、Eq. 1–12 的依赖和奖励形式化、Figure 2 的系统边界、Table 2 的 surface/verification 对照、Figure 6–7 的案例、Table 4–5 的消融和 Figure 8 的人评关系。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: Appendix A 放指标算法和 Eq. 13–14，C 放三套 verifier prompt，D/E 放类别热图与 GGBench，F 放五个案例。附录约 4,730 词，约为正文 4,939 词的 95.8%；主线可读，复现细节和外部证据需跨页查找。
final_judgment.best_pattern: Table 5 的 SFT/RL × text-only/interleaved 交叉设计直接显示 drawing hurts then helps；Table 4 的 leave-one-out 与 Eq. 7–9 对应；Table 2 并排展示 answer、surface 和 functional verification。
final_judgment.largest_gap: 三项条件被称为必要且充分却没有 theorem/proof；RL 与 SFT 同时改变 reward、optimization、sampling，缺少 matched seed/compute；Figure 8 缺少人评流程，聚合表缺少完整 denominator；Figure 12 和 prompts 的浮动/附录位置增加核对成本。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 只要中间产物被主张为推理状态，就分别为其合法性、与当前意图的语义耦合和对后续模型的可读性定义可执行检查，并用组件消融把 surface similarity 与功能证据分开。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 规则适用于具有可执行表示和可判定关系的中间产物。本文只在 GeoGebra/K12 几何及相关 benchmark 验证，不能单独推出对一般多模态任务、开放视觉状态或不同训练规模的转移。
final_judgment.theory_status: Eq. 3–6 是机制解释/诊断，Eq. 7–12 是设计链；没有 theorem、lemma、proposition、corollary 或 proof。
